name: ecoinvent-reviewed-patch-links
semantics: Preserve shared identity fields only. Exact target validation is mandatory. Removed suppliers are errors, not deletions. Background coefficients, uncertainty and LCIA are not equivalent.

reverse_proxies.rationale: Use the older generic organic-chemical market when the unspecified-organics proxy is unavailable. Both represent unweighted chemical averages, but composition and impacts differ; no scientific equivalence is claimed.
